issues.description: Naming inconsistency between PR title/description and on-disk check/CHANGELOG/CheckID
issues.detail: PR title and description say `compute_instance_multiple_network_interfaces`, but the directory, files, class, CheckID, CHANGELOG, and metadata Recommendation.Url all use `compute_instance_single_network_interface`. Confirm the intended canonical slug before merge so the public hub URL, registry, and changelog align with the check that actually ships.

issues.description: GKE detection via `name.startswith("gke-")` is brittle and trivially spoofable
issues.detail: Any operator or attacker can name a multi-NIC VM `gke-foo` to silently downgrade a FAIL to MANUAL, and legitimate GKE node naming is not contractually stable. Detect GKE-managed nodes via the `goog-gke-node` label or instance metadata instead, and document the heuristic's limits in metadata Notes.

issues.description: Zero-interface instances silently report PASS and are untested
issues.detail: When `interface_count == 0` the status falls through to the default PASS while status_extended says "has no network interfaces" — semantically wrong for a single-NIC check and likely indicative of a data-collection failure. Treat as MANUAL/INFO (or skip the resource) and add a test covering this branch.

issues.description: Metadata does not document the MANUAL/GKE outcome that the check emits
issues.detail: metadata.json's Description, Risk, and Notes only describe PASS/FAIL semantics, but the check returns MANUAL for GKE-prefixed instances. Update the metadata to describe the three-state behavior so downstream UI, reporting consumers, and operators correctly interpret MANUAL findings.

issues.description: Network/subnetwork URL parsing drops context and defaults to empty string
issues.detail: `_get_instances` splits self-links on `/` and stores only the trailing name, defaulting missing fields to `""`. Two same-named networks in different projects collide, and an empty NIC name produces output like "has a single network interface: ." Prefer `Optional[str] = None`, fall back to `nic{index}`, or retain the full self-link.

`network_interfaces: list[NetworkInterface] = []` uses a mutable default. Pydantic v1 copies safely, but the pattern is fragile and inconsistent with best practice. Switch to `Field(default_factory=list)` for clarity and forward compatibility with stricter Pydantic versions.

synthesis.summary: The panel unanimously agrees this is a useful, well-tested GCP check with four substantive issues to address before merge. The PR title/description name (`multiple_network_interfaces`) disagrees with every on-disk artifact (`single_network_interface`), risking a broken hub URL and changelog entry. The GKE carve-out relies on a spoofable `gke-` name prefix instead of the authoritative `goog-gke-node` label, allowing trivial bypass of FAIL findings. The zero-interface branch silently reports PASS despite contradictory messaging and has no test, and the metadata does not document the MANUAL outcome the check actually emits. Remaining cleanups around URL parsing defaults and the mutable Pydantic default are minor.
